description: Look up one exact domain in Cloudflare Radar’s global DNS popularity ranking. Returns an exact top-100 rank or a broader popularity group, categories, locations, data dates, and CC BY-NC 4.0 attribution. Not Google SEO difficulty, name competition, or availability. Missing data does not indicate zero competition.

name.description: One ASCII domain label without the extension, such as myproject. Price and link tools only build links from it; availability and popularity tools send the exact domain to their providers.

tld.description: One covered ASCII top-level extension, such as com or .com. Multi-part suffixes and IDNs are not covered.

name: get_domain_popularity

bucket.description: Top-N popularity group, without an exact position inside it. Null does not mean zero competition.

expiresAt.description: Six-hour application cache expiry, not the dataset publication date.

rank.description: Exact global DNS popularity rank, only for the top 100. Not a Google rank.

reportedBucket.description: Provider bucket as supplied, including lower-bound markers such as >200000. A lower bound is not an exact rank or proof of traffic.

ServiceInformation.description: Cheapest Domains identity and optional setup links, separate from upstream evidence. Does not establish client installation or provider health.

outputSchema.description: Successful results are Popularity, the REST 200 response; results with isError: true are Error.

title: Get domain DNS popularity
